subject.title: feat(workspace): add tiered bootstrap loading with configurable bootstrapTier

question: Should OpenClaw accept `agents.defaults.bootstrapTier`, and should the no-override path preserve current `bootstrap-extra-files` behavior for subagent and cron sessions?
rationale: Automation can identify and repair the compatibility defect, but maintainers own whether this new config/API surface should exist and whether any breaking default behavior is intentional.

options.title: Preserve Defaults And Document Tiering
options.body: Keep current no-override hook-extra behavior, make root-only filtering explicit-tier-only, and document `bootstrapTier` before merge.

options.title: Accept Breaking Root-Only Defaults
options.body: Land the no-override source guard only if maintainers explicitly own the upgrade break and add migration or release guidance.

options.title: Defer Config Direction
options.body: Pause or close this PR if tiering should be folded into a broader bootstrap context API instead of a global tier knob.

recommendation.title: Preserve Defaults And Document Tiering
recommendation.body: Keep current no-override hook-extra behavior, make root-only filtering explicit-tier-only, and document `bootstrapTier` before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: This person merged the existing extra-bootstrap behavior and is the strongest available owner for the product/API compatibility choice.
